preconditions.description: The size of the permutation n must be between 1 and 300000.
The length of the permutation must equal n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in permutation)
preconditions.description: All elements in the permutation must be integers between 1 and n.
All elements in the permutation must be unique.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if any(a < b < c or c < b < a for a, b, c in zip(permutation, permutation[1:], permutation[2:])) else stdout == 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if there exists a pair of integers a, b such that a < b < c or c < b < a in the permutation, otherwise output 'NO'.
